 CPSC Posts New Product Recalls and Product Safety Warnings to its Web Site
 Provided by PR Newswire 2026년 10월 22일 오후 2:37:00 
 CPSC Posts New Product Recalls and Product Safety Warnings to its Web Site
 CPSC Posts New Product Recalls and Product Safety Warnings to its Web Site
 PR Newswire
 WASHINGTON, Oct. 22, 2026
 WASHINGTON , Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The CPSC announces today the following product recalls and product safety warnings are posted and can be viewed at  www.cpsc.gov . 
 Lithonia Lighting Recalls RSX Luminaires with Adjustable Tilt Arm Mountings Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Impact Hazard 
 Units: 11,532
 Incidents: 13 reports of adjustable tilt arm mountings breaking, 4 reports of the fixtures falling, no injuries reported
 BAMAMON Recalls LED Projecting Finger Light Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys 
 Units: 6,533
 Costway Recalls Convertible High Chairs Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Fall Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for High Chairs 
 Units: 3,332
 VQQQ Gas Patio Heaters Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards 
 Units: 100
 FoShanShiNanHaiQuNuoAiTongZhuangShangHang Recalls CIYTI Light-Up Princess Costumes Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys 
 Units: 94
 CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using Squishy Toys Immediately Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Water Bead Ingestion; Distributed by Kaizou Group 
 CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using Reliancer Adult Portable Bed Rails Immediately Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Asphyxiation; Violate Mandatory Standard for Adult Portable Bed Rails 
 Units: 237
   CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using PowRyte Pressure Washers Immediately Due to Serious Shock and Electrocution Hazards; Risk of Serious Injury or Death 
 Incidents: 1 report of a unit lacking a GFCI
 About CPSC  CPSC is the federal agency charged with protecting the public from unreasonable risks of injury associated with thousands of types of consumer products. Deaths, injuries, and property damage from consumer product-related incidents cost the nation more than $1 trillion annually. Since the agency was established more than 50 years ago, CPSC has worked to ensure the safety of consumer products, contributing to a decline in related injuries.
 Federal law prohibits any person from selling products subject to a Commission-ordered recall or to a voluntary recall undertaken in consultation with CPSC.
 For lifesaving information: - Visit CPSC.gov. - Sign up to receive our e-mail alerts . - Follow us on Facebook , Instagram , X , BlueSky , Threads , LinkedIn  and Truth Social . - Report a dangerous product or a product-related injury on www.SaferProducts.gov . - Call CPSC's Hotline at 800-638-2772 (TTY 800-638-8270). - Contact a media specialist .
